findings.ac: Stress Cases: missing transitive reference causes build.py to exit status 1
findings.text: test_missing_cited_reference_is_a_fatal_build_error calls build.closure_for on a DIRECT citation ("see references/does-not-exist.md") with an empty tmp_path and only asserts exc.value.code not in (0, None); the transitive branch (an existing reference citing a missing one, queue.extend path) and the real `python build/build.py` exit status 1 are never exercised. A regression that dropped the sys.exit in the transitive path, or a string exit code that did not map to 1, would not fail this test.

findings.ac: Stress Cases / Compilation Invariant (all emitted skills)
findings.text: build_bundle copies src/skills (concept-brainstorm, load-memory, micro-tdd, plan-html) with copytree and never calls closure_for, so a missing cited reference in those 4 execution skills does not make build.py exit 1; only the committed-dist checks test_every_cited_reference_is_shipped_inside_the_skill / test_every_cited_reference_ships would catch it, and no test asserts the build-time fatal behavior for them.
